senses.gloss:
बधिरय् बधिर˚यति pp. बधिरित make deaf,
deafen.

बाध् बा॑धते (बा॑ध˚ति), pp. बाधित॑ oppress,
torment, beset, hurt, injure, remove, annul. C. बाधयति oppress,
vex, pain, fight. D. बीभत्सते feel aversion or loathing (abl.). I.
बाबधे or बद्धधे॑ press heavily, confine, hem in. — अति
afflict or distress hard (acc. or gen.). अप drive away, remove (also
C.). D. have a loathing for (abl.). अभि press hard, pain, vex,
obstruct. अव keep off. आ press against, torment, distress. उद्
break forth. नि press down, hem in, beset. निस् keep off. परि keep
off, exclude or prevent from (abl. or gen.), protect from (abl.);
 vex,
harass, pain. प्र press forwards, urge on, further;
 drive back, repel,
torment, afflict, molest, injure, abolish, undo. प्रति drive back,
ward off, hem in, disturb, afflict. वि press or drive asunder, repel,
afflict, pain, hurt, injure. सम् press together, oppress, afflict,
torment.

बाध॑ m. oppressor, tormentor;
 (also f. आ) oppression,
annoyance (also बा॑ध), opposition, resistance, pain, distress,
injury, damage, expulsion, removal, annulment, contradiction, absurdity.

बाधक f. ˚धिका molesting, afflicting, paining,
injuring, removing.
बाधितत्व n. the being suspended or set aside.

बाधितव्य a. to be oppressed, molested, pained,
suspended, annulled, or set aside.
बाध्व m. N. of a Ṛṣi.
